task: v_hyp_finals R26F-4 (exp89s = exp85a + DIS 2.25, no SEC) skeptic: value + feasibility
reason:
The file is fine. What R26F-4 adds to it is not. exp89s (8ed72e32, a one-line diff from exp85a, ~0.4 GPU-h, sensible gate) is already scheduled by the morning scan: dummy R26M-4 (1), slots A4 and B2. The finding's own claims fail.
(1) The 'mechanism' is double-counted. The dummy lab uses the official metric, so its numbers already include the node term. exp88a vs exp70g = -0.0008 (TP 2047->2046, FP 101->103). exp89q vs exp89p = +0.0004 (TP/FP unchanged, node term only). The old exp13 lab gives -0.0007. The edge churn (1.45% SCIP replay) is about 20x the node change, so '+0.0006-0.0007 on any embryo' is not a floor. The evidence mean is ~-0.0003, not the +0.0004 used in mc26.
(2) The finals advantage is an assumption, not a result. In mc26_grid4, {exp89s,exp75} .851 vs {exp85a,exp75} .825 comes only from the assumed DD ~ N(+0.0004, 0.0008). The .851 vs .812 over exp89q comes only from the assumed SEC mean of -0.0008. With DD mean <= 0, exp89s is no better than exp85a as V_pub.
(3) The trigger cannot measure DIS. Expected +0.0006 is below the 0.001 display step, so exp89q vs exp89p is roughly a coin flip. 'exp89r minus probe 51's CI step' combines three rounded displays (error up to ~+-0.0015). The lab sign of DIS also depends on the base (-0.0008 on exp70g, +0.0004 on K+SEC), so a K+SEC read does not transfer to the K base.
(4) Rule conflict. It adds a second pre-score rule for the same M2 slot, on different variables from the morning table: A4 is 'otherwise', and B2 already makes exp89s M1 in branch B, which would make R26F-4's M2 a duplicate. Two rules for one slot invite post-hoc choice.
(5) 'Runtime same as exp85a' is unverified. The DIS 2.25 dummies ran 1,894 s (exp88a) vs 1,654 s (exp88b, same batch) and 1,576 s (exp89q) vs 1,313 s (exp89p). DIS may slow the ILP by 15-20%. Hidden L could reach ~8.3 h: still under the fail-soft 9.5 h deadline, so this is not fatal.
fix: Do not log R26F-4 as its own trigger. Keep exp89s only as the morning table has it (R26M-2 A4/B2, dummy R26M-4 (1)), under a single pre-score rule. Drop the 'exp89r minus the CI step' DIS read. When exp89s reads, it enters the card only through rule v4 on its own display vs exp85a ('+' >= 0.959 or an attributable '0u'). Do not add a 'preferred V_pub' tag based on a DIS or SEC prior. Correct the card's DIS line to 'formula + already inside the lab; lab -0.0008 / +0.0004, old lab -0.0007, public unread; net prior ~0 to slightly negative'. Add 'runtime: dummy +15-20% vs sibling, check the ILP share' to the exp89s gate note, keeping the rule-v2 limit of <= 2,100 s. Gate as in R26M-4: nodes -1.2%..-0.4% vs 122,328, and no 'Secondary SHA256 7029fe69' line.
realistic_gain: Private: ~0 +- 0.001 (DIS evidence mean ~-0.0003). Public: P(exp89s displays 0.959) ~0.2-0.3, E[max-display gain] ~+0.0002. Finals bronze vs {exp85a, exp75}: ~0 under an evidence-based DIS prior; the +0.026 bronze in mc26 is an artefact of its prior. The R26F-4 trigger adds nothing beyond the morning table's use of exp89s.
